targetable_features.feature: HER2 (IHC 3+, discordant with weak research-grade MXIF) — ADC axis
targetable_features.rationale: Three validated IHC 3+ results (primary 2023, liver met 2023, recurrence 2025) meet the tumor-agnostic T-DXd bar, and T-DXd is already the current therapy. The weak HER2 on 2026-08 research-grade MXIF is DISCORDANT and unresolved; because MXIF is not a validated HER2 assay, it does not overturn the 3+ calls, but it raises real concern for antigen loss in the current tumor. Resolving this (validated IHC +/- ISH on contemporary tissue) is the single most important near-term decision gate: it governs continuing T-DXd (currently poorly tolerated) vs pivoting, and eligibility for other HER2 agents (e.g. disitamab vedotin-class ADCs, HER2 bispecifics — investigational in UC). If the current tumor proves HER2-low rather than 3+, T-DXd retains bystander-payload rationale but with weaker, cross-tumor-extrapolated evidence (tumor-agnostic approval requires 3+) — that lower-certainty framing must carry through.

targetable_features.feature: Nectin-4 (historically highly positive) — re-targeting after EV
targetable_features.rationale: 95-100% membranous expression on two specimens is a strong historical signal, but ~25 months of enfortumab vedotin exposure with subsequent progression means acquired resistance — including Nectin-4 downregulation — is plausible and CURRENT expression is unverified (2026-06 Nectin-4 imaging result not in record). Any Nectin-4 re-treatment or next-generation Nectin-4 agent (novel-payload ADCs, radioligands — investigational) should be gated on contemporary expression, and prior-EV exposure is an exclusion in some trials. Severe CIPN from EV argues against re-exposure to MMAE-payload agents specifically.

targetable_features.feature: TROP2 (low positive on research assay) — bystander-payload ADC axis, hedged
targetable_features.rationale: Weak TROP2 on 2026-08 MXIF is a low-positive signal, not a negative. TROP2-directed ADCs with membrane-permeable bystander payloads (sacituzumab govitecan-class, datopotamab deruxtecan-class) can act on antigen-low/heterogeneous tumors, and their urothelial development has not been strictly expression-gated — so this remains a real option, mostly via trials (the sacituzumab govitecan mUC accelerated approval was withdrawn after its confirmatory trial). Predictive-certainty hedge: low expression is a weaker, less reliable predictor of benefit than strong expression; the pending validated 2026-08 IHC tier should be retrieved before weighting this option.

targetable_features.feature: Mesothelin (strong on research-grade MXIF) — CAR-T/TCE/ADC trial axis, hedged
targetable_features.rationale: Strong mesothelin on MXIF is a genuine lead for mesothelin-directed trials (CAR-T, T-cell engagers, ADCs), and the patient's banked apheresis product/PBMCs lower the barrier to cell-therapy manufacture. Hedge: the assay is research-grade multiplex immunofluorescence, not a validated clinical mesothelin IHC, and mesothelin is atypical in urothelial carcinoma — confirm with a validated stain (tissue-scarcity caveat: nodal biopsies carry 5-10% tumor content) before treating this as an actionable target.

targetable_features.feature: MUC1 (strong on research-grade MXIF) — hedged, confirmation-first
targetable_features.rationale: Strong MUC1 on MXIF supports screening for MUC1-directed vaccines/CAR/TCE trials. Same hedge as mesothelin: research-grade assay, no validated IHC tier yet, and MUC1's ubiquitous low-level normal-tissue expression makes clone/threshold selection decisive — treat as a confirmation-first, lower-certainty lead.

targetable_features.feature: PRAME + HLA-A*02:01 — ImmTAC/TCR axis, pending expression
targetable_features.rationale: The patient is HLA-A*02:01-positive, satisfying the HLA gate for current PRAME-directed ImmTAC/TCR-bispecific agents (brenetafusp-class, investigational in solid tumors), and PRAME-directed imaging was completed 2026-08. The expression result is not yet in the record: this feature is conditional — actionable only if PRAME expression confirms positive at each trial's required threshold. The prior MAGE-A4 lesson (HLA match, expression negative) is the template: expression testing first.

targetable_features.feature: Personalized neoantigens — vaccine + adoptive cell therapy axis
targetable_features.rationale: Active personalized vaccine program (peptide programs 2025, mRNA series 2026) against 24 predicted neoepitopes, with EliSpot showing modest, CD4-skewed immunogenicity so far (2/14 pools at 4 months). Extensive banked material (serial PBMCs, CD8 T cells, apheresis x2, dendritic cells, EBV-LCLs, fresh-frozen tumor) plus engaged academic partners make vaccine-primed TIL/ACT expansion and EV-based immunopeptidomics feasible next steps. Hedge: no objective-response evidence yet attributable to vaccination; ctDNA rose through most of the vaccine period; this is a hypothesis-stage axis whose next readout is post-mRNA EliSpot.

targetable_features.feature: TMB 12.4 mut/Mb + ongoing immune sensitivity — checkpoint re-intensification (ipilimumab addition)
targetable_features.rationale: TMB above the >=10 mut/Mb TMB-H bar (cross-assay hedge: measured on an institutional panel, threshold validated on a different assay) and a deep prior response to PD-1-based therapy support checkpoint re-intensification, e.g. adding CTLA-4 blockade (ipilimumab) — a strategy the care team is already exploring. Hedge: progression occurred ON pembrolizumab maintenance, so single-axis re-challenge is weakly supported; PD-L1 heterogeneity (CPS 5 primary / CPS 0 met) further weakens PD-L1-gated predictions. NK-cell + IL-15 superagonist (N-803) single-patient-IND discussions are part of this immune-intensification axis (investigational, non-standard).

targetable_features.feature: FAP-positive stroma — imaging/theranostic axis, heavily hedged
targetable_features.rationale: FAP+ stroma on MXIF suggests FAPi radioligand imaging/therapy concepts (investigational). Hedge: the only FAPi PET on record (2025-09) showed avidity in BCG-granulomatous prostate tissue and NO FAP-avid urothelial carcinoma, and granulomatous inflammation is a classic FAPi false positive — this is currently an imaging-research lead, not a treatment lead, pending the 2026-06 repeat FAP imaging read.

targetable_features.feature: ARID1A / TERT promoter / TP53 mutations — hypothesis-grade synthetic-lethality axis
targetable_features.rationale: ARID1A loss-of-function supports ATR-inhibitor and related DNA-damage-response trial rationale (hypothesis-grade; no approved agent); TERT promoter and TP53 are prognostic/monitoring markers with no direct drug. Load-bearing gap: the record states exactly one alteration carries an OncoKB treatment interpretation but never names it, and FGFR3 (erdafitinib-actionable in mUC) status is unknown — retrieving the full NGS report may reveal a stronger genomic option than anything listed here.
